SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Kali. fcy.]
Acidity of stomach ; sour eructations ; much flatulence, sour or tasting of ingesta pressure at stomach after eating, accompanying symptoms of uterus.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Kali. fcy.]
Feeling of weakness and bearing down in bowels, particularly if bearing down extends to back.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Kali. fcy.]
Menses too frequent and too profuse, or late.
Menorrhagia, three or four ounces a day, painless.
Passive, painless flowing of blood of natural color, rather thin, and causing much debility.
Leucorrhœa like pus, yellowish, cream-like, profuse, not irritating.
Leucorrhœa only after menses, usually in daytime.
Pain in small of back, accompanying leucorrhœa.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Kali. fcy.]
Sensitiveness of lower part of abdomen to pressure, and womb very tender to touch of finger. θ Pregnancy.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Kali. fcy.]
Fatty heart, with weak, irregular pulse.
Hypertrophy, with dilatation.
Functional disorders of heart, with anemia.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Kali. fcy.]
Pain in small of back accompanying leucorrhœa.
   

   

TISSUES. [44] [Kali. fcy.]
Chlorosis, with cardiac debility.
